profile.name: Halim
profile.intro: I build modern web applications, SaaS platforms, business management systems, and AI-powered solutions. I help startups, businesses, and digital agencies turn ideas into reliable software through clean engineering, practical problem-solving, and scalable architecture.

contact.availability: Open to international projects and agency partnerships
contact.intro: Have a project, need extra development capacity, or want to integrate AI into your product? Let's discuss how I can help. Available for remote collaboration with clients and agencies across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and internationally.

projects.title: SIBAQUI
projects.description: A sports events platform that helps participants discover running events, register for races, and access event information while giving organizers tools to manage their events.

projects.title: Private School Management System
projects.description: A school management application designed to streamline administrative workflows, organize school data, and support multilingual usage with offline-capable local data storage.

projects.title: Clinic Management Application
projects.description: A desktop application concept for managing clinic workflows, patient records, appointments, and medical administration through a focused interface and local database.

projects.title: Supermarket Cashier & Stock Management System
projects.description: A supermarket management application designed to support inventory tracking, cashier and administrator workflows, and low-stock monitoring with multilingual support.

projects.title: COCO
projects.description: An e-commerce platform concept for product discovery, online orders, administration, and delivery workflows tailored to the Algerian market.

projects.title: AI Document Analysis
projects.description: An intelligent document-processing project exploring OCR and local AI models to extract and analyze information from identity documents and other structured documents.

projects.title: Diabetes Care Mobile App
projects.description: A mobile app for people with diabetes to log and review blood glucose readings, track nutrition and activity, export health reports, and quickly access emergency contacts.

projects.title: AGRI-AI Command
projects.description: A control dashboard for an agricultural robot that detects weeds in live camera feeds with YOLOv8, tracks robot status and detection analytics, and guides a robotic arm to treat each target precisely.

projects.title: Workshop Order Management
projects.description: A management application for workshops to track customer orders, calculate material and labor costs, assign craftsmen and organize deliveries, with a full Arabic right-to-left interface.
